subject: POC: NovaCorp - Proposed timeline & success criteria
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Bryan Lee <bryan.lee@novacorp.com>, Alice Turner <alice.turner@novacorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC: NovaCorp - Proposed timeline & success criteria

Thanks for a productive call earlier, Bryan + Alice — appreciate the context and the clear goals. Per our discussion, I pulled together a concise POC plan for alignment. Please review and flag anything missing.

High-level success criteria (what NovaCorp told us matters):
- Integration: basic end-to-end inference calls against Nova data (via s3 connector)
- Latency: 95th percentile < 200ms for typical 256-token prompts
- Quality: parity with your internal baseline on the 10 canonical prompts we discussed (90%+ relevance/accuracy)
- Security: SOC 2 evidence + audit logs available during the trial period

Evaluation plan:
- Phase 1 (Integration & Sanity): get a small test dataset flowing; verify tokenization, schema, and basic responses
- Phase 2 (Load & Latency): run representative traffic profile at peak qps to validate 95th percentile latency target
- Phase 3 (Quality Readout): run the canonical prompt set, collect evaluations, and compare to your baseline

Proposed timeline / milestones (flexible):
- Kickoff + environment access (Week 0): target week of 7 Jun 2027
- Week 1: integration + smoke tests (owner: Vivek)
- Week 2: load testing + latency tuning (owner: Vivek / Rishi)
- Weeks 3-4: guided evaluation runs + quality checks (owner: Aisha)
- Final readout: end of Week 4 with results, recommendations, and next-step commercial proposal

Ownership & roles:
- Redwood: Marissa (overall), Vivek (SE lead), Aisha (CS lead), Rishi (solutions/runtime support), Dev (security)
- NovaCorp: Bryan (sponsor), Alice (integration lead), Legal (contracts)

Next steps:
1) Can we lock kickoff for the week of 7 Jun? Prefer June 8 or 9 for a 60-min kickoff.
2) Please confirm your internal success criteria above (esp the latency target).
3) I attached a short POC checklist and an initial SOW draft for transparency.

Attachments: [Attachment: poc-checklist.xlsx (xlsx)], [Attachment: SOW-draft-v1.pdf (pdf)]

Thanks — looking forward to kicking this off.


Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0197

From: Bryan Lee <bryan.lee@novacorp.com>

Cc: Alice Turner <alice.turner@novacorp.com>, Legal Team <legal@novacorp.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC: NovaCorp - Proposed timeline & success criteria

Marissa — thanks, this looks great and aligns with what we discussed. A couple of clarifications from our side:
- Success criteria additions: please include stability under sustained traffic (we'll validate over 2-hour windows) and a target throughput of ~50 qps during the load test.
- Latency: 95th < 200ms is acceptable as a target; we'll also surface 99th percentile if anything spikes.
- Quality: Alice will own the canonical prompt set and the scoring rubric.

Logistics:
- Kickoff week of 7 Jun works. Alice prefers June 9th at 10:00 AM PT.
- Procurement: I'll engage our procurement team right after kickoff; legal has a couple of standard redlines, but nothing blocking right now.

I'll loop in our procurement lead once we have a confirmed kickoff slot.

Thanks — Bryan

Quick security / infra notes ahead of kickoff:

- Please provide IP ranges or a short-term VPN plan for allowing Redwood test VMs to hit your staging endpoints.
- I'll send a short security questionnaire to your security contact to capture required controls and logging expectations.

I'll attach the questionnaire and our standard network checklist. If you prefer a call with our security engineer, happy to set that up during week 0.
